✦ COMBAT PUNCHY — 1.3.0 ✦

More Punchy between attacks. Your weapons ready when the fight starts.

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge | Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge

⚔️ Weapons on your back

  • Added cosmetic back displays for eligible weapons.
  • Your offhand weapon rests on your back outside combat and returns when entering battle mode or actively using it.
  • Your last selected main-hand weapon moves to your back while you hold tools, blocks or another non-weapon item.
  • Shields sit upright in the center of your back, with their own size and rotation settings.
  • Back weapons follow Punchy! Moves animations and Epic Fight’s animated torso.
  • Axes, shovels, pickaxes, hoes and Epic Fight fists/gloves are excluded from back displays.
  • Respects Moves’ delayed hand swaps to prevent duplicate weapon visuals during transitions.

🎬 Punchy between attacks

  • Restored Punchy’s first-person visuals during idle moments, including while battle mode remains active.
  • Epic Fight still handles attacks, guards, skills, hit reactions and supported native stances.
  • Replaced only Punchy’s whole-battle-mode handoff, preserving its other built-in compatibility and armor handling.

⚙️ Adjust your weapon placement

  • Added configurable rotation, pitch, yaw, scale and back offset.
  • Added per-item overrides for larger weapons and custom models.
  • Refined default weapons to 85% scale, with handles tilted 6° inward toward the head.
  • Shields use an independent default scale of 75%.
  • Individual overrides can be changed live and cleared to restore global settings.

🔧 Compatibility

  • Updated compatibility for Punchy 3.2a and Punchy! Moves 1.0.8 on both loaders.
  • Retained automatic combat entry on attacks and incoming hits, item-switch exit and the configurable seven-second inactivity timeout.
  • Punchy and Moves remain optional. No WeaponMaster dependency is required.
  • Back displays are cosmetic and currently render on your own avatar only; inventory slots and item use remain unchanged.
